caption:
When should a doctor tell you not to get a treatment?
More often than a price list suggests.

A consultation has three answers, not two: yes now, not yet, and not this one. "Not yet" is not a refusal - it is a timing. Active irritation, a deadline inside two weeks, a reference photo brought instead of a concern, or a plan that grew while you were sitting there. Each of those changes what should happen first.

One test before you book: write down what you noticed, wait two weeks without collecting new reference photos, and read your own sentence again. If it reads the same, it is yours.

General education only.

#AestheticConsultation #InformedConsent #KoreanAesthetics #MedicalAesthetics #BetterDecisions
first_comment: Has a doctor ever told you not to do something - and were they right? I ask because the ones who say wait are usually the ones you go back to.
